correctness.rationale: Neighborhoods in KG(7,2) consist of 10 two-subsets disjoint from a given pair; a nonempty simplex is equivalent to a graph-edge set on at most 5 of the 7 symbols. Independently deduplicated all 21 neighborhoods to 17724 faces and confirmed dimensions 0..9 counts (21,210,1225,3360,4872,4340,2520,945,210,21); inclusion–exclusion gives same vector. For all 15 S7 conjugacy classes, independently computed signed setwise-invariant-face reduced Lefschetz traces, agreeing with -sgn(g)*(f(g)^2-3f(g)+1) when concentrated H3 is used. Nilakantan–Singh 2018 Theorem 1.3 supplies the exact concentration wedge^{29} S3 for the matching k=3 parameter, so signed Euler traces identify the actual H3 character, not a virtual module. Algebraically split f²-3f+1 as characters of S^(5,2) and wedge² standard S^(5,1,1), then twist by sign to obtain partitions (2,2,1,1,1) dim14 and (3,1,1,1,1) dim15. The average character is zero, so barycentric subdivision/invariants identify rational reduced homology of X/S7 as zero. Computation is exhaustive at all 15 types, not an inference from selected permutations.
